Computational replications of published neuroscience studies using TVBO.

Only studies whose source work is already published appear here. TVBO's study
database holds many more replication specifications whose results are still
embargoed; those are deliberately not rendered. To build or run a replication
yourself, use the **`replicating-studies` skill**, which turns a paper into a
single declarative `SimulationStudy` plus an honest, fully computed report.

See **[the replication pipeline](pipeline.qmd)** for how a study becomes generated
simulations, figures, and HPC jobs from one declarative spec. A study's figures are
declarative too — **[specify a figure](../Simulation/Figures.qmd)** covers the grammar, and
**[custom figure panels](custom-panels.qmd)** the escape hatch for a paper's bespoke panels.
